## Profile

- Research Interest: AI. Neuroengineering. Biogerontology. Neuroscience. Philosophy. Physics. Robotics.
- Ideas: The tera-human is the next step—urgently, before we reach AGI.
- Origin: Shiraz, c.2000. Ankara intervened. Hamburg persists.
- Premise: One human psychologist. One human information technologist.

- Hobbies: Anime. Tech exploration. Scientific and philosophical literature. Games with depth. Long discussions on philosophy and science. Ping-pong. Basketball.
